focus.name: actor-collision-shared-reinitializer-semantic
focus.purpose: Promote the shared actor-collision interaction reinitializer and terminal-response tail to stable collision-service identities.

targets.name: ActorCollision_ReinitializeFromInteractionTemplate
targets.contract: Select the established interaction-response or Type-0x84 template according to the current actor state, perform guarded audio preparation, reinitialize the actor, and apply the phase-controlled facing mutation.

targets.name: ActorCollision_ApplyTerminalResponse
targets.contract: Accumulate the receiving actor response byte, arm the scene countdown for selected receiving types, clear linked/current resources, initialize the terminal Type-0x84 template, and conditionally queue audio command 3.

contracts: The shared reinitializer remains the common actor-collision interaction cleanup path, including its Type-0x2D interaction-response and Type-0x84 replacement branches.
The terminal-response tail remains distinct from the shared reinitializer and owns response-counter, countdown, linked-cleanup, terminal-template, and optional audio behavior.
Both function ranges are exact and non-overlapping in the whole-ROM instruction database.
evidence: Exact whole-ROM caller/callee and RAM-access context
limitations: The names identify shared collision-service roles, not every user-facing interaction that reaches them.
The precise semantic meaning of the current-actor type discriminator in the reinitializer remains documented conservatively.
